channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Milei diz que virá ao Brasil para evento do PL e visita a Bolsonaro
item.description: Argentine President Javier Milei confirmed he will visit Brazil on July 25 to attend the PL party's national convention in São Paulo, invited by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, the party's pre-candidate for president. During his trip, Milei also plans to visit Brasília to meet with former President Jair Bolsonaro, who is under house arrest. Milei reiterated his support for Flávio Bolsonaro's candidacy and expressed hope that the 'blue wave' of right-wing momentum in South America will extend to Brazil in the 2026 elections.

item.title: Lula conversa com presidente da Venezuela e oferece ajuda para reconstrução do país após terremotos
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva phoned Venezuela's acting president, Delcy Rodríguez, to offer Brazilian government assistance for reconstruction following June's earthquakes, which caused 3,685 deaths and nearly 17,000 injuries. Lula reaffirmed Brazil's commitment to continue humanitarian aid, including shipments of medicines, water purifiers, and field hospital infrastructure, as well as support from the MST with doctors and food supplies.

item.title: Em telefonema, Delcy agradece ajuda do Brasil e Lula reafirma apoio à reconstrução da Venezuela
item.description: President Lula spoke with Venezuelan Presidenta Delcy Rodríguez by phone to reaffirm Brazil's support for reconstruction efforts following the June earthquakes that killed nearly 4,000 people. During the call, Delcy thanked Brazil for humanitarian aid and detailed ongoing victim searches and plans to rebuild housing for thousands of displaced families. Brazil has so far sent six humanitarian flights, 60 tons of supplies, a field hospital, and rescue teams, and is preparing a new phase of assistance.

item.title: Haddad diz que críticas de Tarcísio a Tebet e Marina foram ‘agressão gratuita’ a duas mulheres
item.description: Fernando Haddad criticized Governor Tarcísio de Freitas' remarks as a 'gratuitous aggression' against Senate pre-candidates Marina Silva and Simone Tebet, emphasizing their public service and right to run in São Paulo. Haddad accused Tarcísio of hypocrisy, noting the governor himself is not a São Paulo native and transferred his electoral domicile to the state in 2022. He also claimed that recent São Paulo governors, including Doria and Tarcísio, have prioritized presidential ambitions over state planning.

item.title: Haddad, sobre rejeição: A campanha é um pouco nacionalizada, não tem como se dissociar
item.description: Fernando Haddad, the PT's pre-candidate for São Paulo governor, attributed the 47% rejection rate recorded by Datafolha to the nationalization of the state race and the influence of social media on electoral debate, stating that the campaign cannot dissociate itself from these national factors.

item.title: EUA convidam chanceler brasileiro para evento sobre terrorismo político
item.description: U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio invited Brazilian Foreign Minister Mauro Vieira to attend a July 16 event on the 'resurgence of transnational left-wing extremist terrorism' as defined by the Trump administration. The invitation follows diplomatic tensions, including Washington's dismissal of Vieira's remarks about potential U.S. military action in Brazil as 'absurd', and the State Department's prior denial of any military intervention in Brazil.

item.title: Pré-campanhas de presidenciáveis se dividem sobre uso de inteligência artificial nas eleições
item.description: Presidential pre-campaigns are divided on the use of artificial intelligence in elections: while Lula’s PT advocates using AI only as a support tool without replacing the candidate’s image and criticizes opponents for manipulating truth, allies of Flávio Bolsonaro say they will use IA within legal limits, citing engagement. The PT released a social media video denouncing the use of AI to create 'fake candidates,' referring to the bolsonarist opposition.

item.title: Ciro evita ato de Flávio e sinaliza que aliança entre PSDB e PL ficará restrita ao Ceará
item.description: Ciro Gomes avoided attending the PL’s campaign launch event in Ceará led by Flávio Bolsonaro, signaling that the PSDB-PL alliance will remain limited to the state. Although the agreement includes mutual support — PL backing Ciro for governor and PSDB endorsing Alcides Fernandes for Senate — both sides wish to avoid a national political association due to potential costs. The move reflects a strategy to keep agendas separate, considering Ciro’s past ties to Lula and Flávio’s reluctance to align nationally with bolsonarismo beyond Ceará.

item.title: Edinho liga para Patrus, diretório sinaliza apoio e definição do candidato do PT em Minas depende de conversa com Lula
item.description: The national PT leadership approached federal deputy Patrus Ananias to discuss a possible candidacy for governor of Minas Gerais, with the state directory's approval. The decision hinges on a conversation between Patrus and President Lula, who is expected to formally invite him to run. Patrus, a former mayor of Belo Horizonte and minister under Lula and Dilma, is regarded as a historic figure capable of building broad support for the state race.

item.title: O novo telefonema de Lula para a presidenta da Venezuela
item.description: President Lula called Venezuela's interim president Delcy Rodríguez to reaffirm Brazil's solidarity following the June 24 earthquakes. Rodríguez thanked Brazil for sending 12 tons of medical supplies and conducting over 1,200 medical consultations. She reported that search efforts for victims continue and that Venezuela is preparing for reconstruction, focusing on housing for the 17,907 people left homeless.

item.title: Milei diz que pretende visitar Bolsonaro durante viagem ao Brasil
item.description: Argentine President Javier Milei announced he will visit Brazil in late July, intending to meet with former President Jair Bolsonaro, who is under house arrest, and attend the PL national convention in São Paulo to support Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential candidacy. The meeting with Bolsonaro requires authorization from Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes. Milei also outlined a South American tour including Peru, Colombia, and Ecuador.

item.title: Milei anuncia viagem ao Brasil em julho para apoiar candidatura de Flávio Bolsonaro ao Planalto
item.description: Argentine President Javier Milei announced a trip to Brazil on July 25 to support Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential pre-candidacy, with events in São Paulo and a visit to jailed former president Jair Bolsonaro in Brasília. The meeting underscores a broader strategy of aligning with the international right, following a prior meeting in Argentina where Milei had already endorsed Bolsonaro as the 'presidential candidate'.

item.title: Patrus avança com candidatura em MG e baterá martelo em reunião com Lula
item.description: Deputy Patrus Ananias (PT-MG) awaits a meeting with President Lula to finalize his candidacy for governor of Minas Gerais in 2026, following pressure from the national PT leadership. Despite launching a pre-candidacy for federal deputy re-election, he remains open to running for the state government, viewed as a respected figure with strong polling numbers. The PT is pursuing its own candidacy after the withdrawal of allies like Rodrigo Pacheco and Kalil, while Marília Campos has agreed to run for the Senate.

item.title: Lula telefona para Delcy e promete ajudar na reconstrução da Venezuela
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva pledged Brazilian support for Venezuela's reconstruction following deadly earthquakes that left nearly 4,000 dead and caused an estimated $37 billion in damages. In a phone call with Venezuelan Vice President Delcy Rodríguez, Lula reaffirmed Brazil's solidarity and confirmed the delivery of humanitarian aid, including 210 tons of food and medical supplies, as well as the deployment of over 80 firefighters in UN-coordinated rescue operations.

item.title: Partido Novo pagou R$ 385 mil à empresa de Deltan Dallagnol via fundo partidário
item.description: The Novo Party transferred R$385,000 via party funds in 2025 to a company owned by former federal prosecutor and congressman Deltan Dallagnol. The company, in which Dallagnol, his wife, and children are partners, received the money according to TSE data. The payment raises concerns about the use of public funds to benefit entities linked to political figures within the party.

item.title: Quem é Mariângela Fialek, a Tuca, suspeita de operar esquema envolvendo emendas
item.description: Mariângela Fialek, known as Tuca, a Chamber of Deputies employee and former trusted aide to ex-House Speaker Arthur Lira, is identified by the Federal Police as a central figure in a scheme to divert parliamentary amendments for the benefit of Valdemar Costa Neto, PL party president who holds no elected office. Currently assigned to the PP leadership — Lira’s party — she is suspected of operating the scheme involving misappropriation of public funds earmarked for amendments.

item.title: Ciro Gomes foge de associação com Flávio Bolsonaro no Ceará, governado pelo PT
item.description: Ciro Gomes, the PSDB's pre-candidate for governor of Ceará, is avoiding association with Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), claiming the link is a PT strategy to weaken his campaign. Despite Flávio's efforts to build an alliance with the PSDB in the state, Ciro denies having an open dialogue with the senator and awaits his party's decision on a possible coalition. The absence of Priscila Costa, backed by Michelle Bolsonaro, at Flávio's event in Fortaleza removes a barrier to a PL-PSDB alliance.

item.title: Caiado promete “alforriar” as ‘favelas’ do Rio
item.description: Former Goiás governor and presidential pre-candidate Ronaldo Caiado promised to use his experience fighting organized crime to 'emancipate' Rio de Janeiro's favelas, stating he will free the communities by imprisoning criminals. He expressed confidence that he will liberate all areas currently dominated by organized crime.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro sai em defesa de Valdemar, investigado por desvio de dinheiro público
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro defended PL party president Valdemar Costa Neto after Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino blocked R$119.2 million in his assets over suspicions of irregular parliamentary amendments. Bolsonaro called the Federal Police action selective and criticized alleged political persecution against government opponents, while asserting Valdemar acted within his regular party duties.

item.title: Eleições 2026: Como está a aprovação de Lula a menos de 100 dias do pleito | CNN 360º
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's approval rating is declining less than 100 days ahead of the 2026 elections, according to recent polls from CNN 360º. The downward trend reflects public dissatisfaction with the economy, persistent inflation, and perceptions of inefficiency in public management, which could jeopardize his re-election bid.

item.title: Lula adota entendimento do Itamaraty sobre risco de ação militar dos EUA, mas vê sanção econômica como mais provável
item.description: Lula agreed with Itamaraty's assessment that the U.S. designation of PCC and CV as terrorist organizations opens the possibility for U.S. military action in Brazil, though this scenario is seen as remote. The government considers economic sanctions more likely, as U.S. law allows criminal penalties for individuals and entities doing business with designated terrorist groups, potentially affecting Brazilian sectors where the PCC has infiltrated, such as fuels and fintechs.

item.title: Milei vem ao Brasil para lançamento da candidatura de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Argentine President Javier Milei confirmed a visit to Brazil at the end of July to attend the PL national convention, where he will accompany the launch of Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential campaign. He also plans to visit former president Javier Milei confirmed he will visit Brazil in late July to attend the PL party’s national convention in São Paulo, where he will support the launch of Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential candidacy. Milei also intends to visit former president Jair Bolsonaro, who is under house arrest in Brasília, pending authorization from Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes. The visit underscores Milei’s growing political backing for Flávio Bolsonaro, following their prior meeting in Argentina.

item.title: Nome de Patrus Ananias ganha força e conversa com Lula deve definir candidatura do PT em MG
item.description: Federal deputy Patrus Ananias (PT) has emerged as the party's leading candidate for governor of Minas Gerais after being mentioned in a meeting with President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. Discussions have advanced, and the final decision now depends on a direct conversation between Lula and the deputy. The PT aims to solidify his name to lead the state ticket in 2026.

item.title: Promotora que classificou como ‘inconstitucional’ fala sobre Deus em evento é alvo de denúncias
item.description: Prosecutor Elayne Christina da Silva Rodrigues of the Rio de Janeiro Public Ministry faced complaints after calling an evangelical prayer at a public event in Duque de Caxias 'unconstitutional', arguing that religious faith should not be imposed in public spaces. Her remarks sparked controversy, drawing both support and criticism, including references from senator and 2026 presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ).

item.title: Renan Santos diz que emendas são 'Banco Master dos deputados e presidentes de partidos'
item.description: Presidential pre-candidate Renan Santos accused parliamentary amendments of functioning as a 'Master Bank' for deputies and party presidents, implying illicit use of public funds. He also argued that PL party leader Valdemar Costa Neto should be detained in a maximum-security prison.

item.title: Lula avalia tarifaço dos EUA como cenário mais provável, mas aposta em negociações até o último dia
item.description: The Lula administration views the imposition of 25% U.S. tariffs on Brazilian exports as the most likely outcome by Wednesday, April 15, but continues negotiations until the last moment without conceding on issues like Pix. Officials estimate 4,100 Brazilian products could be affected, including sugar, ethanol, and aluminum hydroxide, and say Brazil will calibrate its response only after the U.S. decision is final.

item.title: Emendas de Valdemar: R$ 80 milhões foram para cidades comandadas pelo PL
item.description: Over R$ 80 million in federal budget amendments were directed to cities with mayors or vice-mayors affiliated with the Liberal Party (PL), according to an investigation showing Valdemar Costa Neto, PL president, controlled these funds despite holding no elected office. Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino blocked the execution of these amendments following a Federal Police probe linking them to Valdemar’s directives. Key beneficiary cities include Suzano (SP), Porto Seguro (BA), and Santa Fé do Sul (SP), all governed by PL-aligned administrations.

item.title: China é “obcecada” por terras raras e Trump tem “inveja”, diz Lula
item.description: President Lula stated that China is 'obsessed' with retaining knowledge about critical minerals and rare earths, and that U.S. President Donald Trump is 'envious' of that position. He said he previously thought Brazil was nearly illiterate on the topic, but the meeting clarified the situation.

item.title: TRE do Rio aprova pedido de auxílio de forças federais para segurança durante eleições
item.description: The Rio de Janeiro Regional Electoral Court unanimously approved the request to deploy federal forces to strengthen security for the October general elections in the state. The request will be forwarded to the Superior Electoral Court (TSE), which will make the final decision on approving the deployment.

item.title: Deputada faz maior emenda Pix da Câmara para cidade do marido candidato
item.description: Deputy Alessandra Haber (Podemos-PA) allocated R$18.8 million in a single Pix amendment for urban paving works in Ananindeua, a city previously managed by her husband, who is a pre-candidate from the same party for governor of Pará. This is the largest Pix amendment in the Chamber of Deputies this year.

item.title: Recarga do Gás do Povo é liberada nesta sexta (10/7). Confira detalhes
item.description: The Caixa Econômica Federal released a new phase of the Gás do Povo program on Friday, July 10, providing free 13kg cooking gas refills to 206,000 low-income families nationwide. Created by President Lula’s government, the initiative offers up to six annual refills per household based on size, requires a per capita income of up to half the minimum wage and updated CadÚnico registration, and aims to reach 15 million families by December 2026 with a total investment of R$1.5 billion.

item.title: "Fora, Zema", ouve presidenciável mineiro durante caminhada em BH
item.description: Presidential pre-candidate Romeu Zema (Novo) faced a protest during a visit to Belo Horizonte's Central Market, where a woman shouted 'Fora Zema'. Despite the incident, he was welcomed by supporters, took photos with shopkeepers, and attended a business lunch, joined by allies including Governor Mateus Simões (PSD) and other Novo party candidates.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro defende Valdemar Costa Neto e critica atuação ‘de forma seletiva’ da PF
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL-RJ pre-candidate for President of Brazil, defended PL party president Valdemar Costa Neto and criticized the Federal Police for acting selectively. The statement was posted on social media on Friday, April 10.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro aciona conselho contra promotora que criticou oração em evento no Rio
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) filed a complaint with the CNMP against prosecutor Elayne Christina da Silva Rodrigues of the MPRJ for labeling an evangelical prayer at a child protection event as 'unconstitutional'. The prosecutor stated the prayer violated secularism and her freedom of speech, while the senator argues that labeling all public religious references as unconstitutional undermines religious freedom, particularly in an event focused on child welfare.

item.title: Flávio defende Valdemar e acusa PF de atuar de “forma seletiva”
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro defended PL party president Valdemar Costa Neto following a Federal Police operation linked to parliamentary amendments. He said Valdemar will provide all necessary answers and accused the PF of acting selectively.

item.title: Flávio sai em defesa de Valdemar e critica PF por caso Lulinha
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) defended PL president Valdemar Costa Neto after Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino ordered the suspension of R$119 million in parliamentary amendments over suspected irregularities linked to Valdemar. Bolsonaro accused the Federal Police of selectively targeting opponents of President Lula’s government, drawing a parallel to the delayed testimony of Lulinha in the INSS investigation. He expressed confidence that Valdemar would clarify the allegations and defended his political activity as legitimate due to leading Brazil’s 'largest party'.

item.title: Flávio sai em defesa de Valdemar e diz que PF atua de forma seletiva
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) defended Valdemar Costa Neto, president of the Liberal Party, after Supreme Court Justice Flávio Dino ordered the freezing of R$119.2 million in Valdemar’s assets over alleged parliamentary embezzlement. Flávio accused the Federal Police of selective action against political opponents of the Lula government, contrasting it with the lack of investigation into Lulinha, the president’s son. He stated Valdemar, as head of Brazil’s largest party, naturally engages with federal deputies and will adequately respond to the allegations.

item.title: Defesa de Valdemar vê “exposição eleitoral” em decisão de Dino
item.description: The defense of Valdemar Costa Neto, president of the PL party, criticized Minister Flávio Dino's STF decision to freeze R$119 million in suspicious amendments as a premature public exposure of an investigation lacking solid evidence, arguing it improperly criminalizes political-party activity. Flávio Bolsonaro, a PL presidential pre-candidate, defended Valdemar, accusing the Federal Police of selective action and political persecution against opponents of President Lula's government.

item.title: TRE-RJ vai pedir que tropas federais atuem no estado nas eleições
item.description: The Regional Electoral Court of Rio de Janeiro (TRE-RJ) will request the Superior Electoral Court (TSE) to deploy federal troops during the 2026 elections due to armed criminal groups exercising territorial control, especially in the Rio Metropolitan Area. The measure, unanimously approved by the TRE-RJ and supported by interim governor Ricardo Couto, follows a practice in place since 2012, as electoral justice asserts that free voting is not guaranteed in areas dominated by organized crime.

item.title: Comissão aprova reestruturação do quadro de pessoal do TRT da 4ª Região
item.description: The Constitution and Justice Committee of the Chamber of Deputies approved a bill to restructure the workforce of the Regional Labor Court of the 4th Region (TRT-4), creating 16 substitute labor judge positions, seven appointed positions, and 165 commissioned roles, while converting 48 chief of staff positions into advisory roles, at an annual cost of R$18.6 million. Reporter Afonso Motta (PDT-RS) stated the measure corrects a historical deficit and strengthens judicial efficiency in Rio Grande do Sul. The proposal now requires a plenary vote in the Chamber before advancing to the Senate.

item.title: Caiado alfineta Flávio sobre possível perda de apoio: “O barco está afundando”
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado criticized the potential decision by the União Brasil and Progressistas federation to withdraw support from Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential pre-candidacy, stating that 'the boat is sinking and allies are already jumping off'. The remark came in response to rumors of declining backing for Senator Flávio Bolsonaro. Caiado positions himself as a pre-candidate for the 2026 Brazilian presidency.

item.title: Pivô de crise entre Michelle e Flávio falta a evento, e PL abre caminho para aliança com Ciro Gomes
item.description: The absence of councilwoman Priscila Costa, supported by Michelle Bolsonaro, at an event in Ceará due to a purported mission in Portugal, cleared the way for Flávio Bolsonaro to advance an alliance with Ciro Gomes (PSDB) in the state. Priscila’s candidacy would jeopardize the alliance, as the PSDB is expected to name the second candidate on the PL’s Senate ticket. The episode deepened the rift between Michelle and Flávio, resulting in Michelle’s resignation from the PL Women’s leadership and seen as a political victory for Flávio.

item.title: Vídeo: Senado Aprova: "Pix Pensão"
item.description: The Senate approved the 'Pix Pension' bill, which automates monthly alimony payments via bank transfer, even without a formal employment link to the debtor, reducing judicial overload. Additionally, PL 4.636/2020 was approved, subjecting political parties to anti-money laundering regulations, requiring them to monitor suspicious financial transactions. Both bills now proceed to presidential sanction and Chamber of Deputies voting, respectively.

item.title: O rosto da democracia brasileira
item.description: Brazil has approximately 159 million registered voters for the 2026 elections, the largest electorate in its history, with growth stabilizing compared to 2022. The majority voter profile is a parda woman with completed high school education, aged between 35 and 44. Young voters aged 16–17 and seniors over 70 total 20.5 million, forming a key demographic for voluntary electoral engagement.

item.title: Mensagens de advogado do PL revelam desvio de emendas por Valdemar, aponta PF: ‘24 milhões tá bom’
item.description: The Federal Police identified PL party president Valdemar Costa Neto as the mastermind behind a scheme diverting R$119 million in parliamentary amendments from the secret budget, based on intercepted messages between his aides and party lawyers. In an August 2025 conversation, lawyer Garigham Amarante Pinto proposed allocating R$24 million to Tourism, with Mariângela Fialek confirming the amendments were being registered under Valdemar’s name. The defense claims the asset freeze is based on weak premises and political criminalization, while Senator Flávio Bolsonaro accuses the PF of selective action.

item.title: Marília Arraes lidera disputa ao Senado em PE, diz pesquisa
item.description: Marília Arraes (PDT) leads the Senate race in Pernambuco with 50.5% to 51.9% of voting intentions, according to a Paraná Pesquisas survey. Humberto Costa (PT) follows in second place with 40.6% to 43.3%. The survey, registered with the TSE under PE-00478/2026, interviewed 1,500 people between July 7 and 9, 2026, with a margin of error of 2.6 percentage points and a 95% confidence level.

item.title: União Progressista pode ficar fora de apoio nacional a Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The União Progressista federation, formed by União Brasil and Progressistas (PP), may not formally endorse Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL-RJ) presidential pre-candidacy. The parties are likely to maintain state-level autonomy, allowing regional directories to define alliances based on local interests, following recent strains in their relationship with the senator.

item.title: Valdemar direcionou R$ 119 milhões em emendas mesmo sem mandato, diz PF
item.description: The Federal Police submitted a report to Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino indicating that PL party president Valdemar Costa Neto directed R$119 million in parliamentary amendments despite holding no legislative office, using Chamber of Deputies staff as intermediaries in an informal scheme. Investigations show that former aide Mariângela Fialek (‘Tuca’) operationalized the transfers, including R$24 million earmarked for tourism, with awareness among officials of the scheme’s clandestine nature. Dino ordered payment blocking, stating Costa Neto lacks legal authority to allocate public funds, while his defense called the measure premature and politically motivated during an election year.

item.title: Comissão do Senado analisa porte de arma para mulheres sob medida protetiva
item.description: The Senate Public Security Committee is reviewing PL 3.272/2024, which would allow temporary firearm carry for women over 18 under urgent protective orders, lowering the age threshold from the standard 25 under the Disarmament Statute. Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), the rapporteur, recommends approval with conditions, including termination of authorization upon revocation of the protective order. The agenda also includes PL 3.890/2020, establishing a Victims' Statute focused on restorative justice.

item.title: O recado de Lula a Trump às vésperas de decisão sobre novo tarifaço
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva stated that Brazil holds significant reserves of critical minerals, including rare earths and lithium, and will use these resources to drive national development while maintaining sovereign control over its wealth. The remarks come amid rising trade tensions with the United States, following Washington's announcement of new tariffs on Brazilian goods, with Lula suggesting that Trump may begin to worry about Brazil's growing strategic role in the global supply of minerals vital for technology and energy transition.
